results.answer: Hello! Welcome to Stackular — feel free to ask me anything about our services or company. 👋
Stackular was founded by Jason Storch (Founder & CEO) and Venkat Varkala (Founder & CTO).
Stackular has offices in Columbia, Maryland (USA), Chicago, Illinois (USA), Hyderabad (India), and San José (Costa Rica).

results.q: Does Stackular have an office in Chicago?
results.answer: Yes, Stackular has an office in Chicago, Illinois, USA.

Stackular offers a range of services, including:

- AI‑driven solutions (Artificial Intelligence, Agentic AI, Generative AI, Data Intelligence)  
- Product development and enterprise systems  
- Cloud infrastructure and digital experience design  
- Managed services and modern workplace solutions  
- Service desk support and UI/UX design audits

results.q: Which industries does Stackular work with?
results.answer:
Stackular serves a range of industries, including:

- Government (civilian and defense/intelligence)  
- Commercial  
- Healthcare and life sciences  
- Financial services  
- IT & cloud services (GSA MAS)
Stackular’s core values are Empathy and Deliver Results.
